title: High-Intensity Tabata Burn
description: An intense 20-minute HIIT workout following the Tabata protocol. This workout alternates between 20 seconds of maximum effort and 10 seconds of rest. Perfect for burning fat and building cardiovascular endurance in a short time.
shortDescription: Intense 20-minute Tabata protocol for maximum fat burn
cautions: Consult doctor if you have heart conditions

steps.instruction: Warm up with light jogging in place for 3 minutes
Burpees - 20 seconds all-out, 10 seconds rest
Mountain climbers - 20 seconds all-out, 10 seconds rest
Jump squats - 20 seconds all-out, 10 seconds rest
High knees - 20 seconds all-out, 10 seconds rest
Repeat steps 2-5 for 8 total rounds
Cool down with walking and stretching

modifications.description: Reduce work intervals to 15 seconds and increase rest to 15 seconds
Add weights to jump squats or wear a weighted vest

title: Morning Sun Salutation Flow
description: A gentle yet invigorating yoga sequence perfect for starting your day. This classic Sun Salutation flow warms up the entire body, improves flexibility, and creates mental clarity through synchronized breath and movement.
shortDescription: Gentle morning yoga flow to energize your day
cautions: Avoid if you have wrist injuries
Move slowly if you have back pain

steps.instruction: Mountain Pose - Stand tall with feet together, hands at heart center
Upward Salute - Inhale, raise arms overhead
Forward Fold - Exhale, fold forward at hips
Half Forward Fold - Inhale, lift halfway with flat back
Plank Pose - Step or jump back to plank
Chaturanga - Lower down with control
Upward Dog - Push through hands, open chest
Downward Dog - Lift hips, form inverted V
Return to standing through Forward Fold
Repeat flow 5 times, ending in Savasana

modifications.description: Keep knees bent in Forward Fold, drop knees in Plank
Add jump-throughs and jump-backs between poses

title: Full Body Strength Builder
description: A comprehensive 45-minute strength training workout targeting all major muscle groups. Using compound movements, this workout builds muscle, increases strength, and improves overall body composition.

steps.instruction: Warm up: 5 minutes of light cardio and dynamic stretches
Barbell Squats - 4 sets of 10 reps
Bench Press - 4 sets of 10 reps
Bent-Over Rows - 4 sets of 10 reps
Overhead Press - 4 sets of 10 reps
Deadlifts - 4 sets of 8 reps
Pull-ups - 4 sets to failure
Cool down and stretch

modifications.description: Reduce weight and increase reps, use machines instead of free weights
Increase weight, add drop sets, reduce rest periods

title: 30-Minute Cardio Blast
description: An energetic cardio workout designed to elevate your heart rate and burn calories. This workout combines various cardio exercises to keep things interesting while maximizing fat burn and cardiovascular benefits.

steps.instruction: Warm up with marching in place and arm circles
Jumping jacks - 1 minute
High knees - 1 minute
Butt kicks - 1 minute
Jump rope or imaginary rope - 2 minutes
Rest - 30 seconds
Repeat circuit 3 times
Cool down with walking and stretching

modifications.description: Reduce intensity, march instead of jump, take longer rest breaks
Add burpees between exercises, increase speed, reduce rest

title: Deep Stretch & Flexibility
description: A relaxing 25-minute flexibility routine focusing on deep stretches for all major muscle groups. Perfect for recovery days, improving range of motion, and reducing muscle tension.

steps.instruction: Seated Forward Fold - Hold for 2 minutes
Pigeon Pose - Each side for 2 minutes
Lying Spinal Twist - Each side for 90 seconds
Child's Pose - Hold for 2 minutes
Lizard Pose - Each side for 90 seconds
Seated Spinal Twist - Each side for 1 minute
Butterfly Stretch - Hold for 2 minutes
Final relaxation in Savasana

modifications.description: Use props like blocks and straps, reduce hold times
